entries.text: `apply_rewrite("drop_literal_row_source", ..)` replaces the one-row `(VALUES (1)) AS dual(dual_col)` source of a dead `UNION ALL` leg with a `FROM`-less `SELECT`; the golden corpus records TPC-Havoc `17_v4` on PostgreSQL as the changed output. `flatten_count_of_count` is available the same way. The runtime writes no `FROM VALUES` or `dual` source in any dialect.
